title: Hashar mein rang layega
body:
Hashar mein rang layega
(Shaheed e kerbala, hey deen ki baqa, zabi hey nainawa husain badshah) x2
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Ayengi jab fatema) x2
haal-e- perishan dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Roo baru baba kay jab khatoon jannat e ayengee , khali joli sarwar-e- konain ko dekhlai gee , (phir yakee kehlayenga) x2
Mehshar ka maidan dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Rakhdiya barchi ne akber ka kaleja cheer ke, Rukh badal dale hai ummat ne teri tasweer ke, (Malike kawsar zaraa) x2
Ummat ke ehsan dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Asgare masoom ke lab par sawaale aab hai, Bund paani ke liye wu kis kadar betab hai, (Nehr se paani nahi) x2
deytay musalman dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zainab o kulsoom say kehta tha shimr e baad gohar , shaam mein jawonge nange sar phirongi dar badar, (Karbela ke baad ab) x2
Tarikh zindaa dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Gham bhalaa gulzaar ka is dil ko roze hashar ka, Jo hai awlaade payamber ki muhabbat se bharaa, (Baksh wa denge use) x2
Yasrab ke sultan dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Hasher mein rang laiga khune shahida dekhna) x2
